criteria.ready: Regular IT courses offered

indicators.evidence_guidance: Record the source and enough detail for another reviewer to verify the rating.

indicators.label: Teacher to student Ratio

criteria.nascent: Staffing below the agreed teacher-to-student benchmark.
criteria.emerging: Staffing near the benchmark, with class coverage gaps.
criteria.ready: Staffing meets the agreed benchmark and class coverage needs.

indicators.evidence_guidance: No ratio benchmark is supplied. Ratios are shown, but readiness is Not assessable pending an agreed benchmark.

indicators.label: Teachers available for all classes

criteria.nascent: Teachers unavailable for all classes.
criteria.emerging: Partial class coverage or shared teachers across grades.
criteria.ready: Teachers available for all classes.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Bare counts or comments about class grouping do not establish teacher coverage.

indicators.label: Individual Classes Held (not grouped classes)

criteria.nascent: Most or all classes grouped across grades.
criteria.emerging: Some grades grouped and others taught separately.
criteria.ready: Separate grade-level classes held.

indicators.evidence_guidance: No is interpreted against the source question asking whether classes are grade-specific.

indicators.label: Special Educators availability

criteria.nascent: No special educators available.
criteria.emerging: Special educators present, but adequate grade coverage is not established.
criteria.ready: Special educators present with reported teacher coverage for every class.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Headcount alone supports Emerging. Coverage does not establish specialisation in every subject.

indicators.label: School admin invests in quality of education, encourages higher education and not just shelter

criteria.nascent: Administration prioritises shelter or is not focused on education.
criteria.emerging: Mixed or average educational focus.
criteria.ready: Administration  focuses on quality of education and supports higher education.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Generic Yes answers the source question about higher education.

indicators.label: Braille Teaching Support, students write their own tests/exams, not just oral

criteria.nascent: Predominantly oral teaching or minimal Braille writing support.
criteria.emerging: Limited Braille expertise in some grades with oral/scribe dependence for exams.
criteria.ready: Braille teaching to enable independent written work/exams supported across grades.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Plain Yes is Emerging because independent exams are not separately confirmed.

indicators.label: ECCE Taught in school

criteria.nascent: No early foundational teaching and no ECCE support interest reported.
criteria.emerging: Early foundational teaching or ECCE interest reported, but a full programme is unconfirmed.
criteria.ready: ECCE programme explicitly implemented.

indicators.evidence_guidance: T and AB are proxies. Negative answers to both do not verify absence of a named ECCE programme.

indicators.label: VICT support from school

criteria.nascent: No willingness to support VICT reported.
criteria.emerging: School interested in supporting VICT.
criteria.ready: Active VICT support implemented.

indicators.evidence_guidance: AC measures interest, so Yes supports Emerging rather than Ready.

indicators.label: School teaches Self Organizing Skills (SOS) in all grades

criteria.nascent: SOS not taught across grades.
criteria.emerging: SOS taught in some grades or inconsistently.
criteria.ready: SOS taught in all grades.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Use the all-grades scope of the source question.

indicators.label: Good internet connectivity

criteria.nascent: Internet absent, unavailable or poor.
criteria.emerging: Internet available but reliability average or unconfirmed.
criteria.ready: Good internet connectivity reported.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Plain Yes means Emerging until reliability is confirmed.

indicators.label: Students participate in extra curricular activities

criteria.nascent: No extracurricular participation reported.
criteria.emerging: Participation exists but access is limited or inconsistent.
criteria.ready: Students participate in extracurricular activities.

indicators.evidence_guidance: The source measures participation, not universal student coverage.

indicators.label: Students participate in district/ state/ national level competitions

criteria.nascent: No district/state/national competition participation.
criteria.emerging: Competition or event participation reported but external level unclear.
criteria.ready: District, state or national participation explicitly reported.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Disability Day events are not automatically treated as competitions.

indicators.label: After School Support

criteria.nascent: No after-school learning support.
criteria.emerging: Some after-school support reported, but regularity unclear.
criteria.ready: Regular structured after-school learning support.

indicators.evidence_guidance: A generic Yes or hostel teaching supports Emerging until regularity is confirmed.

indicators.label: Employment Readiness Programs

criteria.nascent: Not offered/Rarely offered
criteria.emerging: Offered adhoc
criteria.ready: Planned employment readiness training and support provided

indicators.evidence_guidance: Record the source and enough detail for another reviewer to verify the rating.

indicators.label: Qualified Science Teachers available

criteria.nascent: No qualified Science/Maths teachers available.
criteria.emerging: Combined Science/Maths teacher availability reported, but Science qualification and coverage unclear.
criteria.ready: Science-qualified teacher coverage explicitly established.

indicators.evidence_guidance: K combines Science and Maths, so positive counts are Emerging rather than proof of Science-specific qualification.

indicators.label: Tactile Books Availability (RLF, etc)

criteria.nascent: No tactile books available.
criteria.emerging: RLF/tactile books present but adequacy across grades unclear.
criteria.ready: Adequate tactile learning books available across grades.

indicators.evidence_guidance: A generic book Yes does not identify tactile books.

indicators.label: Functional Science Lab

criteria.nascent: No functional science lab.
criteria.emerging: Lab present but regular functioning not established.
criteria.ready: Functional science lab with regular student lab classes.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Same source and criteria as Resources row 5.

indicators.label: Grade till which Science and Maths are taught

criteria.nascent: Science/Maths stop below the highest grade offered.
criteria.emerging: Subjects taught through the highest grade offered, but grade-specific delivery unconfirmed.
criteria.ready: Subjects taught through the highest grade offered with grade-specific delivery confirmed.

indicators.evidence_guidance: W records grade reach, not subject quality. Equal grade reach supports Emerging; Ready also requires separate classes.

indicators.label: Written Math support

criteria.nascent: No or very little written Maths support.
criteria.emerging: Some Taylor Frame/Abacus support, limited use or mixed provision.
criteria.ready: Written Maths support using appropriate tools and independent written work confirmed.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Tools or generic Yes alone support Emerging; they do not establish independent mathematical writing.

indicators.label: Grade till which Science and Maths are taught

criteria.nascent: Science/Maths stop below the highest grade offered.
criteria.emerging: Subjects taught through the highest grade offered, but grade-specific delivery unconfirmed.
criteria.ready: Subjects taught through the highest grade offered with grade-specific delivery confirmed.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Same grade-reach rule as Science row 41.

indicators.label: Nemeth support

criteria.nascent: No Nemeth teaching/support, explicitly confirmed.
criteria.emerging: Some Nemeth teaching/support, with limited coverage.
criteria.ready: Consistent Nemeth teaching and student use.

indicators.evidence_guidance: No Nemeth-specific field is provided. Do not infer from Braille or Taylor Frame.

indicators.label: Maths on computer in middle and high school

criteria.nascent: No computer-based Maths teaching, explicitly confirmed.
criteria.emerging: Some computer-based Maths teaching, with limited coverage.
criteria.ready: Regular accessible computer-based Maths teaching.

indicators.evidence_guidance: Computer/lab availability does not establish Maths-on-computer teaching.
